column1: # Broadcast week fields handled by the decoder.
# source              identifier passed to the decoder
# week_bits           width of the transmitted week field
# absolute            yes -> the field already carries the full week number and
#                     needs no disambiguation; no -> the field is truncated
# week_epoch          calendar date of day 0 of week 0 for this source
# seconds_behind_gps  constant offset of this constellation's time scale
#                     behind GPS time; add it to reach the GPS scale
# pivot               what a truncated field is resolved against
# The GPS sources share the receiver's internal week numbering
# the era-0 anchor in epoch_anchors.csv. BDT carries its own epoch.

column7: the ephemeris week of the carrying subframe
